candidate_relations.label: Fungal keratitis with deep stromal and pan-corneal infiltrates
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis specifies Exophiala xenobiotica keratitis, a rare dematiaceous fungal keratitis consistent with the brown multilobular deep stromal lesions and the prior Thaumetopoea pityocampa exposure. C001 correctly identifies fungal keratitis with matching anatomical descriptors (deep stromal and pan-corneal infiltrates) but stops at the genus/species level, omitting the specific etiologic agent (Exophiala xenobiotica) required for complete equivalence.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Fungal keratitis is the parent category; Exophiala xenobiotica is a specific dematiaceous (black) fungus requiring species-level identification not captured here

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is highly specific (species-level fungal pathogen); candidate lacks etiologic speciation
Brown multilobular lesions and prior pine processionary exposure are strong contextual clues pointing to dematiaceous fungal etiology, supporting partial but not complete equivalence
